stopPoints.label: Police officers eating donuts at the desk

questions.question:
Question 1 (Story/Reason): 'Why did Peppa's family come to the police station?'
Options: 'A) George lost Mr. Dinosaur 🦖 B) To buy some ice cream 🍦'
Guidance: Encourage the child to say: 'George lost his dinosaur!'

Question 2 (Observation/Action): 'Look at Police Officer Panda! What yummy food is he holding?'
Options: 'A) A pink donut 🍩 B) An apple 🍎'
Guidance: Encourage the child to say: 'He is eating a pink donut!'

Question 3 (Who): 'Who are the two police officers at the desk?'
Options: 'A) Officer Squirrel and Officer Panda 👮 B) Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig 🐷'
Guidance: Encourage the child to say: 'Officer Squirrel and Officer Panda!'

stopPoints.label: The lost and found room full of strange treasures

questions.question:
Question 1 (Story/Place): 'Where did the police officers take Peppa's family?'
Options: 'A) The Lost and Found room 📦 B) The playground 🛝'
Guidance: Encourage the child to say: 'The Lost and Found room!'

Question 2 (Observation/Color): 'Look at the big open chest! What is shining inside?'
Options: 'A) Gold pirate coins 🪙 B) Old dirty shoes 👟'
Guidance: Encourage the child to say: 'Shiny gold treasure!'

Question 3 (Plot): 'Why is there a pirate treasure chest in the police station?'
Options: 'A) Pirates forgot where they buried it 🏴‍☠️ B) Peppa brought it from home 🏠'
Guidance: Encourage the child to say: 'Pirates forgot where they buried it!'

stopPoints.label: Police officers show lost toy dinosaurs to George

questions.question:
Question 1 (Plot/Check): 'Officer Panda is holding a red triceratops and a blue dinosaur. Are these George's dinosaur?'
Options: 'A) No, they are not! ❌ B) Yes, they are! ✅'
Guidance: Encourage the child to say: 'No, they are not George's dinosaur!'

Question 2 (Emotion): 'Look at little George's face. How does he feel right now?'
Options: 'A) Sad and worried 😢 B) Happy and laughing 😄'
Guidance: Encourage the child to say: 'George feels sad.'

Question 3 (Color/Observation): 'What color is the dinosaur sitting on the floor on the left?'
Options: 'A) Purple / Pink 💜 B) Green 💚'
Guidance: Encourage the child to say: 'It is a purple stegosaurus!'

Question 4 (Toy/Identification): 'What color is George's real Mr. Dinosaur?'
Options: 'A) Green 🦖 B) Yellow 💛'
Guidance: Encourage the child to say: 'Mr. Dinosaur is green!'

stopPoints.label: Mr. Dinosaur is finally found in the car boot

questions.question:
Question 1 (Plot/Outcome): 'Where did the clever police officers finally find Mr. Dinosaur?'
Options: 'A) In the car boot (trunk) 🚗 B) At the playground 🛝'
Guidance: Encourage the child to say: 'In the car boot!'

Question 2 (Emotion/Reaction): 'George is holding his green dinosaur again! Is he happy now?'
Options: 'A) Yes, he is very happy! 😊🎉 B) No, he is angry 😠'
Guidance: Encourage the child to say: 'Yes, George is very happy!'

Question 3 (Observation): 'Look at Peppa! What toy is she holding in her hand?'
Options: 'A) Teddy 🧸 B) A toy boat ⛵'
Guidance: Encourage the child to say: 'Peppa is holding Teddy!'
